WPT|/pf.intro: Every protective floor is a system of layers on a prepared concrete substrate: a primer that seals the pores or blocks moisture and oil ({GBM}, {G1270}, {SG3}, {SG3T}, {SG3F}, {SG2}), a scratch coat or mortar where the substrate must be levelled or repaired ({EV200}, {K4031}), the coating that carries the load and the chemicals ({B351}, {V2370}), the seal that gives the surface its finish, colour and slip resistance ({V360}, {V2260} with {ANTI}) and the elastic joint ({IPU}). Two-component epoxy and polyurethane resins that cure by reaction, bonded to the concrete with ≥ 1.5 N/mm², resistant to forklift traffic, oils, acids and alkalis — in layers of 0.1 to 2 mm, walkable after about 12 hours, fully loadable after 7 days.
WPT|/pf.photoCap: The sample: a sawn piece of floor. Untreated, the concrete dusts, drinks water and oil and spalls at the crack; with the ASODUR system the primer seals the pores, the coating carries the load and the seal keeps liquids on the surface. Switch between the bare concrete and the coated floor.

WPT|/pf.hero.note/ref: Bare concrete: the surface dusts under traffic, water and oil are drawn into the pores, a crack opens and its edges spall under the wheel — the floor is cleaned with effort and never looks clean.
WPT|/pf.hero.note/bet: With the ASODUR system: the primer seals the pores and bonds the layers, the coating carries the wheel loads and the chemicals, the seal keeps water and oil on the surface — easy to clean, slip resistant, the joint closed elastically.

WPT|/pf.sub0/1: load-bearing, firm, grippy, dry (≤ 4 CM-% for the resin coatings and seals, ≤ 5 CM-% for {V360}; matt damp substrates get the barrier primers), free of adhesion-inhibiting substances, protected from moisture from behind; tensile adhesion ≥ 1.5 N/mm²; prepared after DIN EN 14879-1:2005, 4.2 et seq. (shot blasting, grinding, vacuuming); 10–35 °C, at least 3 °C above the dew point, max. 80 % relative humidity
WPT|/pf.lb/barrierT: Thixotropic barrier primer, plinth and wall
WPT|/pf.layerT/prep/1: the concrete is shot-blasted or ground to an open-pored, grippy surface, vacuumed dust-free; cracks, breakouts and hollow areas are made good before the primer; the residual moisture and the dew point are checked
WPT|/pf.layerT/clean/1: {R008}, the solvent-free cleaning concentrate, diluted with tap water, sprayed, scrubbed criss-cross until the colour turns brownish, left for approx. 10 minutes, scrubbed again, rinsed with hot water (60–80 °C) and picked up with a wet vacuum; repeated until no oil remains — the surface is not dried off
WPT|/pf.layerT/prime/1: {GBM} (or {G1270}), the low-viscosity two-component epoxy, rolled into the open pores in one or two steps until the surface is pore-sealed; quartz sand Ø 0.1–0.6 mm broadcast onto the fresh last coat as the key for the coating
WPT|/pf.layerT/barrier/1: {SG3}, the solvent-free, moisture-compatible epoxy barrier primer, in two coats on the matt damp or young concrete: watertight against negative pressing water up to 3 bar, diffusion-inhibiting (methane barrier tested); the second coat sanded; {SG3F} where the schedule allows only 3.5 hours between the coats
WPT|/pf.layerT/barrier/4: overcoat after min. 12 h, max. 5 days
WPT|/pf.layerT/barrierT/1: {SG3T}, the thixotropic version of the barrier primer, for the plinth, the wall and overhead, under {V2370} and for the capillary-breaking mortar: sd ≈ 105 m, watertight to 3 bar, EMICODE EC 1PLUS
WPT|/pf.layerT/barrierT/4: overcoat after min. 12 h, max. 5 days
WPT|/pf.layerT/barrierT/5: rubber squeegee, brush, roller or airless spray
WPT|/pf.layerT/oilp/1: {SG2}, the special epoxy primer on the cleaned, still matt damp concrete: it bonds to damp concrete, displaces the water from the capillaries of the surface, blocks capillary-rising oil and vapour (sd > 100 m, class III) and negative water pressure up to 3 bar, radon tight; quartz sand Ø 0.5–1.0 mm over the whole fresh surface
WPT|/pf.layerT/scratch/1: the primer resin ({GBM}, {G1270} or {SG3}) mixed 1 : 1 by weight with kiln-dried quartz sand Ø 0.1–0.6 mm (2–3 % {FF} on slopes), spread in one step with the scratch filler method on the fresh primer and sanded while fresh: it levels roughness and fills the pores before the coating
WPT|/pf.layerT/mortar/1: {EV200}, the flowable three-component epoxy mortar, for breakouts, machine bases, rail grouting and load-distribution layers: 10–200 mm in one skin, self-compacting, without primer, approx. 65 N/mm² after 24 hours; {K4031}, the thixotropic epoxy adhesive, for anchors, bonding and small repairs
WPT|/pf.layerT/mortar/3: approx. 1.9 kg/m² per mm ({EV200}); approx. 1.7 kg/m² per mm ({K4031})
WPT|/pf.layerT/coat/1: {B351}, the pigmented self-levelling epoxy floor coating, spread with the trowel in one pass at approx. 1 mm and rolled criss-cross with the spiked roller to release the air: approx. 70 N/mm² compressive, Shore D approx. 72, Bfl-s1, resistant to acids, alkalis, cleaning agents and tyre softeners
WPT|/pf.layerT/coat/4: walkable after 12 h, full load after 7 days
WPT|/pf.layerT/thick/1: {B351} mixed 2 : 1 by weight with kiln-dried quartz sand Ø 0.1–0.6 mm and spread at approx. 2 mm for high mechanical loads — forklifts, pallet trucks, impacts; de-aerated with the spiked roller
WPT|/pf.layerT/thick/3: approx. 1.2 kg/m² {B351} + 0.6 kg/m² sand per mm
WPT|/pf.layerT/thick/4: walkable after 12 h, full load after 7 days
WPT|/pf.layerT/slip/1: an interspersing coat of {B351} rolled on, quartz sand Ø 0.5–1.0 mm broadcast to excess while fresh, the loose sand swept and vacuumed after hardening, the top seal of {B351} rolled criss-cross: R11 by test report, up to R12
WPT|/pf.layerT/vprime/1: {V360}, the water-emulsified two-component epoxy, diluted with 8–10 % water and rolled criss-cross as the primer of the garage, cellar or warehouse floor; on concrete, cement and calcium sulphate screeds, magnesia screed and sanded mastic asphalt
WPT|/pf.layerT/vlevel/1: pinholes and recesses filled with {V360} + approx. 3 % {FF}, unevenness up to 2 mm levelled with {V360} + 50 % quartz sand Ø 0.1–0.35 mm, sanded with 100 grit and vacuumed after hardening
WPT|/pf.layerT/vseal/1: {V360} rolled criss-cross in one to two steps as the pigmented, satin, vapour-permeable seal: resistant to tyre softeners, dilute acids and alkalis, heating oil and petrol; standard RAL colours; walkable after approx. 16 hours, the garage floor done in two days
WPT|/pf.layerT/vseal/4: walkable after 16 h, full load after 7 days
WPT|/pf.layerT/antislide/1: {ANTI}, the spherical glass granulate (90–150 µm), stirred into the premixed seal at 8–10 % by weight, not more than 170 g/m² in the sealing layer: slip resistance R10 with {V360}, R11 with {V2260}; stirred up during the work so that it does not settle
WPT|/pf.layerT/pu/1: {V2260}, the aqueous two-component polyurethane seal, transparent, light-fast and UV-stable, scratch and abrasion resistant, easy to clean, EMICODE EC 1PLUS: rolled in one step on the cured coating for the showroom and the workshop; slip resistance with {ANTI}
WPT|/pf.layerT/v2370/1: {V2370}, the solvent-free two-component epoxy sealing coating for sewage treatment plants, digestion towers, sewage pipes and steel sheet piles: resistant to sulphuric acid pH 0–1, sewage and sea water, exposure class XWW4 after DIN 19753, elastifying, stray-current insulating; two layers on the primed concrete, on steel the first layer is the primer
WPT|/pf.layerT/v2370/3: approx. 400–500 g/m² per layer on concrete, 250–400 g/m² on steel
WPT|/pf.layerT/v2370/4: overcoat 12–16 h at +20 °C, full load after 7 days
WPT|/pf.layerT/joint/1: {IPU}, the one-component moisture-curing polyurethane jointing compound: the field joints, connection joints and wall joints of the floor cut, primed, backed with a closed-cell cord and filled; 25 % total deformation, Shore A approx. 40, −40 to +80 °C, edges chamfered 45° under vehicle traffic
WPT|/pf.layerT/joint/3: approx. 100 ml/m at 10 × 8 mm … 750 ml/m at 30 × 24 mm
WPT|/pf.layerT/joint/4: skin after 60–90 min, full load after 14 days
WPT|/pf.adv.label: Advantages
WPT|/pf.adv.title: Why the system works
WPT|/pf.adv.cards/0/3: The primer penetrates the open pores and seals them; the tensile adhesion of every primer and coating is ≥ 1.5 N/mm² ({V360} ≥ 2.8 N/mm² on dry concrete, {EV200} and {K4031} ≥ 2 N/mm²) — the concrete fails before the bond.
WPT|/pf.adv.cards/1/3: {B351}: compressive strength approx. 70 N/mm², flexural approx. 44 N/mm², Shore D approx. 72; thick coats filled with quartz sand for high mechanical stress; {EV200} approx. 109 N/mm² under machines and crane rails.
WPT|/pf.adv.cards/2/3: {B351} resists acids, alkalis and cleaning agents at application concentration and the softeners of car tyres; {V2370} resists sulphuric acid pH 0–1, sewage and sea water — exposure class XWW4 after DIN 19753.
